pollinator_behavior.study: Ohashi & Yahara 1998, American Journal of Botany 85(2):219-224
pollinator_behavior.design: Artificially arranged flowering plants with daily Latin square; pollinator visits separately quantified
pollinator_behavior.field_year: not equated with 1993 or 1994 predator cohort
reported_relationships: bumblebee visitation per plant is a decelerating function of floral display size
number of heads visited on each plant increases linearly with display
model-derived visitation rate per head is approximately independent of display size within each observation day
pollinator_behavior.pollination_outcomes_measured: visit rate; NOT independent deposited pollen or final seed set for the same predator-cohort heads

herbivory.study: Ohashi & Yahara 2000, Canadian Journal of Botany 78:230–236
herbivory.plant_scale_model: P_damage(F)=1-exp(-a*F), F=total season florets per mother plant

fit_sites.name: Nikko
fit_sites.response: directly assessed proportion of actual damaged seeds per plant

fit_sites.name: Kawamata
fit_sites.response: INFERRED seed-loss proportion from infested heads; assumes <=one larva per head, mean 451 florets/head, 52 seeds consumed/insect borrowed from Nikko

author_model: F_star=1/a follows only from W(F)=S*F*exp(-aF) with constant set probability S and no male/lifetime tradeoff changes
printed coefficients are rounded, so the published F_star values can differ slightly from 1/a recomputed from printed coefficient
not a causal plant trait optimum demonstrated by selection experiment
study_comparability: Nikko 1993 and Kawamata 1994: different places, elevations and years, so treatment variation in partner guild is confounded
Kawamata seed-loss proportions are partially reconstructed from Nikko per-insect seed consumption, not directly observed damage counts
Site-level seed-feeder composition differs, but its effect cannot be isolated from environment or census protocols
Display (floret count) is not the same variable as authentic spine length, head orientation or phyllary gap
1998 pollinator paper and 2000 seed-predator paper are not the same heads/plants/years and cannot estimate within-head selection gradients

next_empirical_test: Same population and stage, separately compare measured individual head display, geometry, independently recognized pollinator/seed predator contact and final mature achenes including failed approaches
